# The escape hatch. Two primitives answer most questions; the rest need code.
#
# This exists so the vocabulary can stay small. A command per question would grow the
# grammar without limit and couple it to whoever asked for each one.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|c3d4e5f6|call,read,blob,reset,report,gpu
OBS|part|c3d4e5f6|target|deck
OBS|part|c3d4e5f6|gpu|AMD Custom GPU 0405 (gfx1033)
OBS|part|c3d4e5f6|driver|radv 25.1.0
OBS|part|c3d4e5f6|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
# Position-independent machine code, uploaded in bounded chunks so no line exceeds the
# length limit. Identified, so several can be resident at once.
CMD|2|blob|probe1|0x0|554889e5488b45f0
OBS|ack|2|blob
OBS|done|2|returned|0x8|
CMD|3|blob|probe1|0x8|4883c0015dc3
OBS|ack|3|blob
OBS|done|3|returned|0x6|
CMD|4|run|probe1|0x29
OBS|ack|4|run
OBS|done|4|returned|0x2a|
CMD|5|bye
OBS|ack|5|bye
OBS|done|5|ok||
